security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by JavaScript template literals, Markdown, local preview markup, and documented rendering utilities. The audit confirms optional npm bootstrap, dynamic package import, and unescaped innerHTML rendering as capabilities that require review; no credential exfiltration or prompt-injection attempt was found. Static review was capped at 400/847 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 447 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Optional package bootstrap can fall back to @latest.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit version override when the bundled version cannot be determined. Do not bootstrap an unpinned package.

remediation.issue: The design picker builds previews with innerHTML from configuration and prompt values.
remediation.suggestion: Escape text and attribute values or build preview nodes with DOM APIs before assigning user-provided content.

remediation.issue: The loader can execute npm and import resolved package entries.
remediation.suggestion: Keep interactive confirmation mandatory, display exact pinned packages, and restrict package resolution to approved project paths.

content.user_title: Create a HyperFrames video design direction
content.value_statement: Video teams need consistent visual decisions before they build scenes. This skill turns a brief into a practical direction for style, typography, pacing, composition, and narration.
actual_capabilities: Creates a visual design specification for a HyperFrames project.
Recommends palettes, typography pairings, spacing, corners, and depth.
Plans beat structure, narration tone, and scene rhythm.
Selects composition patterns for titles, data, and product stories.
Provides guidance for audio-reactive visual concepts.
Uses bundled frame presets and reference material for design decisions.
limitations: Does not render a finished video by itself.
Does not replace the HyperFrames animation skill for detailed motion patterns.
Design picker previews may load fonts from Google Fonts when opened.
Optional helper scripts can require local Node, npm, Python, ffmpeg, and project dependencies.

use_cases.title: Define a product launch video
use_cases.description: Turn product goals and brand rules into a concise direction for a launch video.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client design brief
use_cases.description: Create a reviewable frame specification before production begins.

use_cases.title: Plan an explainer sequence
use_cases.description: Organize pacing, narration, typography, and visual hierarchy for an explainer.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a visual direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a visual direction for a 30-second product video about [product]. The audience is [audience]. Use a [brand tone] style.

prompt_templates.title: Build a design specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a HyperFrames design specification for [project]. Include palette, typography, spacing, corners, depth, and three composition patterns. Brand constraints: [constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Plan story beats
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan six beats for a [duration] video about [topic]. For each beat, give the message, narration tone, visual hierarchy, and transition intent.

prompt_templates.title: Design an audio-reactive concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose an audio-reactive visual direction for [track or event]. Specify frequency-band mappings, visual restraint, typography treatment, and accessibility considerations.

output_examples.input: Create a direction for a 20-second climate data video.
output: Visual direction: editorial clarity with a deep navy background and coral data accents.
Typography: strong sans-serif headlines and compact labels.
Beat plan: hook, scale of change, key statistic, action, closing message.

output_examples.input: Suggest a frame style for a premium product launch.
output: Style: quiet editorial layout with wide spacing and restrained motion.
Palette: warm off-white, charcoal text, and one muted accent.
Composition: centered product frame, short title card, and concise proof points.

best_practices: Provide the audience, video length, brand constraints, and primary message.
Approve a design specification before producing detailed scenes.
Use readable contrast and short on-screen text for every beat.
anti_patterns: Do not request a complete animation system from this creative-direction skill.
Do not mix several unrelated visual styles in one short video.
Do not rely on preview output without checking brand and accessibility requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces creative direction, design specifications, and planning guidance for HyperFrames videos.

faq.question: Can it render a video?
faq.answer: No. Use HyperFrames production tools to render a completed composition.

faq.question: When should I use the animation skill?
faq.answer: Use it for detailed motion patterns, transitions, and scene blueprints.

faq.question: Can I use an existing brand system?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide your colors, fonts, tone, and layout constraints in the prompt.

faq.question: Does the design picker need internet access?
faq.answer: Its preview can request Google Fonts when opened. Core written guidance does not require it.

faq.question: Are helper scripts required?
faq.answer: No. They are optional utilities for contrast reporting and audio data extraction.
